name: Prelegal Video Game Legal Template Dataset
description: A curated dataset of legal document templates for video game developers, publishers, and community-facing game services. Each template exposes variables that a document generation system can replace with user-specific information.
disclaimer: These templates are provided for informational purposes only and do not constitute legal advice. They are general starting points that must be reviewed and adapted by a qualified attorney licensed in the relevant jurisdiction before use. Placeholders written as double curly braces must be replaced with user-specific information.

sections.heading: Acceptance of This Agreement
sections.body: This End User License Agreement, effective {{effective_date}}, is a legal agreement between you and {{company_name}} for the game {{product_name}} and any related updates, content, or services made available by {{company_name}}. By installing, copying, accessing, or using {{product_name}}, you agree to this Agreement. If you do not agree, do not install or use the game. You must be at least {{age_requirement}} years old to accept this Agreement on your own behalf; otherwise, a parent or legal guardian must accept it for you. The current version of this Agreement is available at {{website_url}}.

sections.heading: License Grant
sections.body: Subject to your compliance with this Agreement, {{company_name}} grants you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable, and revocable license to install and use {{product_name}} for your own non-commercial entertainment purposes on devices that you own or control. This license is for the game as distributed by {{company_name}} and does not transfer any ownership rights to you.

sections.heading: Restrictions
sections.body: You may not sell, rent, lease, lend, sublicense, distribute, or otherwise transfer the game or your license. You may not reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, modify, or create derivative works of the game except to the extent that applicable law expressly permits. You may not remove or alter proprietary notices, bypass technical protection measures, use cheats or automation tools that provide an unfair advantage, or use the game to violate any law or the rights of another person.

sections.heading: Ownership
sections.body: {{company_name}} and its licensors own all right, title, and interest in and to {{product_name}}, including all software, artwork, characters, music, sound, text, trademarks, and other content, together with all intellectual property rights in them. This Agreement grants only the limited license described above. All rights not expressly granted are reserved by {{company_name}} and its licensors.

sections.heading: Updates and Online Services
sections.body: {{company_name}} may provide updates, patches, downloadable content, or online features for {{product_name}}. Some features may require an internet connection, an account, or a subscription. {{company_name}} may modify, suspend, or discontinue online services in its discretion, subject to applicable law. Updates may be required for continued use of the game, and this Agreement applies to all updates unless a separate agreement accompanies an update. Additional terms for online services may be posted at {{website_url}}.

sections.heading: Virtual Items and Purchases
sections.body: {{product_name}} may allow you to purchase or earn virtual currency, items, cosmetics, or other digital content. Virtual items are licensed to you, not sold, and have no cash value. They may not be redeemed for money, transferred outside the game, or exchanged for real-world goods or services except as required by applicable law. All purchases are subject to the refund policy at {{refund_policy_url}} and the rules of the platform through which you purchased the item. {{company_name}} may manage, modify, or remove virtual items as part of operating the game.

sections.heading: User-Generated Content
sections.body: If {{product_name}} allows you to create or share content, you retain ownership of your content. You grant {{company_name}} a worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive license to use, reproduce, display, distribute, and create derivative works of your content as needed to operate, promote, and improve the game. You represent that you have all rights necessary to grant this license and that your content does not violate the rights of others. {{company_name}} may remove content that violates this Agreement or applicable law.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: This Agreement remains in effect until terminated. Your rights under this Agreement terminate automatically if you materially breach it. {{company_name}} may also terminate this Agreement or suspend access to {{product_name}} if necessary to comply with law, protect other users, or discontinue the game. On termination, you must stop using the game and delete all copies in your possession or control. Sections that by their nature should survive termination, including ownership, disclaimers, limitation of liability, and dispute resolution, will survive.

sections.heading: Disclaimers
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, {{product_name}} is provided as is and as available, without warranties of any kind, whether express, implied, or statutory, including warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, title, and non-infringement. {{company_name}} does not warrant that the game will be uninterrupted, error-free, secure, or free of harmful components. Some jurisdictions do not allow the exclusion of certain warranties, so some of the above exclusions may not apply to you.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, {{company_name}} and its directors, officers, employees, agents, and licensors will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, exemplary, or punitive damages, or for loss of profits, data, goodwill, or business opportunity, arising out of or relating to this Agreement or the game, even if advised of the possibility of such damages. The total liability of {{company_name}} arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the amount you paid to {{company_name}} for the game in the twelve months before the event giving rise to the claim, or the minimum amount required by applicable law. Nothing in this Agreement limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

sections.heading: Dispute Resolution
sections.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}, without regard to conflict of law rules. Except where applicable law provides otherwise, disputes will be resolved exclusively in {{venue}}. To the extent permitted by law, you and {{company_name}} agree to resolve covered disputes through final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, and each party waives the right to participate in a class action or representative proceeding. You may opt out of arbitration by sending written notice to {{contact_email}} within {{arbitration_opt_out_days}} days after accepting this Agreement. Claims that may be brought in small claims court or that cannot be arbitrated under applicable law are excluded from this arbitration provision.

sections.heading: Changes to This Agreement
sections.body: {{company_name}} may update this Agreement from time to time. If a change is material, {{company_name}} will provide notice through the game, by email, or on {{website_url}} before the change takes effect, unless a shorter period is required by law or necessary for security reasons. Your continued use of {{product_name}} after the updated Agreement takes effect means that you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this Agreement may be sent to {{company_name}} at {{contact_email}} or through {{website_url}}.

templates.description: A privacy policy template for a game, website, and related online services. It covers data categories, purposes, cookies, sharing, retention, security, children, user rights, and international transfers. Adapt the legal bases and rights sections to the jurisdictions where players live.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This Privacy Policy, effective {{effective_date}}, explains how {{company_name}} collects, uses, shares, and protects personal information in connection with {{product_name}}, {{website_url}}, and related services. It applies to information collected through the game, website, customer support, and events. It does not apply to third-party services that have their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as account details, profile information, purchase information, support messages, and content you submit. We also collect information automatically when you use {{product_name}}, such as device identifiers, IP address, game progress, gameplay events, crash reports, approximate location derived from IP address, and usage data. We may receive information from platforms, payment processors, and marketing partners where you have authorized those disclosures.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
sections.body: We use personal information to provide and operate {{product_name}}, create and manage accounts, process purchases, deliver customer support, maintain security and prevent fraud, detect cheating, personalize and improve the game, analyze usage, communicate with you, comply with legal obligations, and enforce our terms. We may also use information to send marketing communications where permitted by law, and you can opt out at any time.

sections.heading: Legal Bases for Processing
sections.body: Where required by law, we process personal information on the following legal bases: performance of a contract with you, our legitimate interests in operating and improving the game, your consent, and compliance with legal obligations. You may withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent, without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.

sections.heading: Cookies and Similar Technologies
sections.body: We and our service providers use cookies, local storage, SDKs, and similar technologies to operate {{product_name}}, remember preferences, measure performance, analyze usage, and support marketing. Where required by law, we will request consent before using non-essential cookies. You can manage cookies through your browser settings and any consent tools we provide, although disabling some cookies may affect the game or website.

sections.heading: How We Share Information
sections.body: We may share personal information with {{third_party_categories}}. We may also share information with platform providers when you play through their services, with professional advisers, with authorities when required by law, and with a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets. We do not sell personal information for money. Where applicable law defines sale or sharing broadly, we will provide the notices and opt-out rights required by that law.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain personal information for as long as needed to provide the services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. Unless a longer period is required or permitted by law, we generally retain account and gameplay data for {{data_retention_period}}. When information is no longer needed, we delete it or de-identify it.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: We use administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, and alteration. These measures include access controls, encryption where appropriate, monitoring, and vendor oversight. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: {{product_name}} is not directed to children under {{children_minimum_age}}, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under that age without appropriate consent. If you believe a child has provided personal information without the required consent, contact us at {{privacy_email}} so we can take appropriate action. Some features may have additional age restrictions.

sections.heading: Your Privacy Rights
sections.body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to the processing of your personal information, to data portability, to withdraw consent, and to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. To exercise these rights, contact us at {{privacy_email}}. We may need to verify your identity before responding. Where applicable, you may designate an authorized agent to submit a request on your behalf.

sections.heading: International Transfers
sections.body: {{company_name}} may process personal information in countries other than the country where you live. Where we transfer personal information internationally, we use safeguards such as {{international_transfer_safeguards}} and take steps designed to ensure that the information receives an adequate level of protection.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If a change is material, we will provide notice through {{product_name}}, by email, or on {{website_url}} before the change takes effect, unless a shorter period is required by law. The effective date at the top of this policy shows when it was last updated.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: For privacy questions or requests, contact {{company_name}} at {{privacy_email}}. For general questions, contact {{contact_email}}. If a data protection officer or representative has been appointed, their details are: {{dpo_contact}}.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, effective {{effective_date}}, is entered into by {{party_a_name}}, with an address at {{party_a_address}}, and {{party_b_name}}, with an address at {{party_b_address}}. The parties may disclose confidential information to each other solely for the purpose of {{purpose}}. Each party may act as both a disclosing party and a receiving party.

sections.heading: Definition of Confidential Information
sections.body: Confidential Information means any non-public information disclosed by one party to the other, in any form, that is designated as confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential given the nature of the information and circumstances of disclosure. Confidential Information includes business plans, game designs, source code, builds, financial information, player data, marketing strategies, partner lists, and technical information.

sections.heading: Exclusions
sections.body: Confidential Information does not include information that the receiving party can demonstrate: was publicly available at the time of disclosure or later became public without breach of this Agreement; was lawfully known to the receiving party before disclosure; was received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or was independently developed without use of or reference to the disclosing party's Confidential Information.

sections.heading: Obligations
sections.body: The receiving party will use Confidential Information only for the purpose described above, protect it with at least reasonable care, and limit access to employees, contractors, and professional advisers who need to know it and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Agreement. The receiving party will not disclose Confidential Information to any other person without the disclosing party's prior written consent.

sections.heading: Term
sections.body: This Agreement begins on the effective date and continues for one year, unless terminated earlier by either party on written notice. The confidentiality obligations for information disclosed during the term will continue for {{confidentiality_period_years}} years after the date of disclosure. Trade secrets will be protected for as long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.

sections.heading: Return or Destruction
sections.body: On the disclosing party's written request or on termination of this Agreement, the receiving party will promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information in its possession or control within {{return_days}} days, except for copies retained in routine backup systems or as required by law. Retained copies remain subject to this Agreement.

sections.heading: No License or Obligation
sections.body: No license or ownership right in Confidential Information is granted by this Agreement. The disclosure of Confidential Information does not create an obligation to enter into any further agreement or to proceed with the purpose. Each party remains free to develop products and services that may be similar to those discussed, provided it does not use the other party's Confidential Information.

sections.heading: Remedies
sections.body: The parties acknowledge that a breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate. The disclosing party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity. The prevailing party in an action to enforce this Agreement may recover reasonable attorneys' fees and costs to the extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}, without regard to conflict of law rules. The parties agree to the exclusive jurisdiction of {{venue}} for disputes arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

sections.heading: Entire Agreement
sections.body: This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties regarding its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings on that subject. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties. If any provision is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions will remain in effect.

sections.heading: Engagement
sections.body: {{company_name}} engages {{contractor_name}}, with an address at {{contractor_address}}, as an independent contractor to provide services for {{project_description}}. The contractor will perform the services with reasonable skill and care and will follow the reasonable directions of {{company_name}} regarding the project. This Agreement takes effect on {{effective_date}}.

sections.heading: Services
sections.body: The contractor will provide the services described in this Agreement or in one or more written statements of work. The contractor will keep {{company_name}} informed of progress and will promptly notify {{company_name}} of any issue that may affect the project timeline or budget. The contractor may use subcontractors only with {{company_name}} prior written approval, and the contractor remains responsible for the work of approved subcontractors.

sections.heading: Compensation
sections.body: {{company_name}} will pay the contractor {{rate}}. The contractor will submit invoices according to the following schedule: {{payment_schedule}}. {{company_name}} will pay undisputed invoices within {{invoice_due_days}} days after receipt, unless otherwise stated in a statement of work. The contractor is responsible for all taxes, withholdings, and filings arising from the compensation.

sections.heading: Expenses
sections.body: The contractor will be responsible for its own expenses unless {{company_name}} approves an expense in writing before it is incurred. Approved expenses will be reimbursed at cost and must be supported by reasonable documentation. Travel and equipment expenses require prior written approval.

sections.heading: Independent Contractor Status
sections.body: The contractor is an independent contractor and not an employee, partner, agent, or joint venturer of {{company_name}}. The contractor controls the manner and means of performing the services, subject to the project requirements. The contractor is not entitled to employee benefits, workers' compensation, unemployment benefits, or other benefits provided to employees of {{company_name}}. Nothing in this Agreement authorizes the contractor to bind {{company_name}} or make commitments on its behalf.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: The contractor assigns to {{company_name}} all right, title, and interest in and to {{ip_assignment}}, including all copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets, and other intellectual property rights, effective on creation. The contractor will execute any documents reasonably requested by {{company_name}} to confirm or perfect this assignment. To the extent any work product cannot be assigned, the contractor grants {{company_name}} a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free, exclusive license to use it. The contractor retains no right to use the work product for any purpose without {{company_name}} written consent.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.body: The contractor will keep confidential all non-public information received from {{company_name}}, including game designs, source code, builds, business plans, player data, and financial information. The contractor will use this information only to perform the services and will return or destroy it when the engagement ends or on request. These obligations do not apply to information that is publicly available through no fault of the contractor or that the contractor is required to disclose by law, provided the contractor gives {{company_name}} prompt notice where permitted.

sections.heading: Term and Termination
sections.body: This Agreement begins on the effective date and continues until the services are completed or the Agreement is terminated. Either party may terminate for convenience with {{termination_notice_days}} days' written notice. Either party may terminate immediately for a material breach that is not cured within ten days after written notice. {{company_name}} may suspend work and terminate immediately if the contractor violates the confidentiality or intellectual property provisions. On termination, {{company_name}} will pay for services properly performed and approved before the effective date of termination.

sections.heading: Representations and Warranties
sections.body: The contractor represents and warrants that it has the right and authority to enter into this Agreement, that the work product will be original or properly licensed, that the work product will not infringe the rights of any third party, and that the contractor will comply with applicable laws. The contractor will not incorporate third-party materials into the work product without {{company_name}} prior written approval and any required licenses.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}, without regard to conflict of law rules. The parties agree to the exclusive jurisdiction of {{venue}} for disputes arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

sections.heading: Entire Agreement
sections.body: This Agreement and any incorporated statements of work are the entire agreement between the parties regarding its subject matter and supersede all prior or contemporaneous understandings. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties. If any provision is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions will remain in effect.

sections.heading: Engagement
sections.body: This Revenue Share Agreement, effective {{effective_date}}, is entered into by {{developer_name}} and {{publisher_name}} for the development, publishing, and commercialization of {{product_name}}. The developer will develop and deliver the game, and the publisher will fund, publish, market, and distribute the game on the platforms described below. The parties will cooperate in good faith on the launch and ongoing operation of the game.

sections.heading: Definition of Net Revenue
sections.body: Net Revenue means the gross amounts actually received by the publisher from sales and monetization of {{product_name}} on {{platform_definition}}, less platform fees, payment processing fees, refunds, chargebacks, taxes, and other pass-through costs specifically identified in this Agreement. Net Revenue does not include amounts from sources not expressly covered by this Agreement unless the parties agree in writing. The publisher will maintain records sufficient to calculate Net Revenue.

sections.heading: Revenue Share
sections.body: Subject to recoupment as described below, the publisher will pay the developer {{developer_revenue_share_percentage}} percent of Net Revenue. The publisher retains the remainder. The revenue share applies during the term and for so long as the publisher continues to commercialize {{product_name}}, unless the parties agree otherwise in writing.

sections.heading: Recoupment
sections.body: The publisher may recoup {{recoupment_amount}} from Net Revenue before paying the developer revenue share. Recoupment applies only to the amount stated and to costs expressly identified in this Agreement. Once recoupment is complete, the developer share will be paid on all subsequent Net Revenue. The publisher will provide a recoupment statement with each report until recoupment is complete.

sections.heading: Reporting and Payment
sections.body: The publisher will provide {{reporting_frequency}} reports showing gross sales, deductions, Net Revenue, recoupment, and amounts payable to the developer. The publisher will pay undisputed amounts within {{payment_days}} days after the end of each reporting period. Payments will be made in U.S. dollars by a mutually agreed method. The developer may request reasonable supporting detail for any report.

sections.heading: Audit Rights
sections.body: The developer may audit the publisher's books and records relating to {{product_name}} once per year on reasonable notice, during normal business hours, and at the developer's expense. The audit may cover the {{audit_period_years}} years before the request. If an audit reveals an underpayment of more than five percent for the period audited, the publisher will reimburse the reasonable cost of the audit and pay the underpayment promptly.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: The developer retains ownership of the game, its source code, artwork, characters, and other original content, subject to any rights granted to the publisher in this Agreement. The publisher receives a license to publish, market, distribute, and commercialize {{product_name}} during the term and in the territories covered by this Agreement. Each party retains ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property and grants only the rights expressly stated in this Agreement.

sections.heading: Marketing and Promotion
sections.body: The publisher will use commercially reasonable efforts to market and promote {{product_name}}, including store page management, promotional assets, and launch activities. The developer will provide reasonable marketing materials and approvals within agreed timelines. The publisher will not make material claims about the game that are misleading or inconsistent with the developer's approved materials.

sections.heading: Term and Termination
sections.body: This Agreement begins on the effective date and continues until the parties agree to end it or the publisher stops commercializing {{product_name}}. Either party may terminate for a material breach that is not cured within thirty days after written notice. If the publisher terminates without cause, the developer's accrued revenue share remains payable. After termination, the publisher may continue to sell existing inventory or fulfill platform obligations for a reasonable wind-down period, and revenue from those sales remains subject to this Agreement.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}, without regard to conflict of law rules. The parties agree to the exclusive jurisdiction of {{venue}} for disputes arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

sections.heading: License Grant
sections.body: This Asset License Agreement, effective {{effective_date}}, is entered into by {{licensor_name}} and {{licensee_name}}. The licensor grants the licensee a {{exclusivity}} license to use {{asset_description}} in connection with {{product_name}}. The license is limited to {{territory}}, lasts for {{license_term}}, and is subject to the terms of this Agreement.

sections.heading: Permitted Uses
sections.body: The licensee may use the assets for {{permitted_uses}}. The licensee may modify the assets as reasonably necessary to integrate them into the game, provided the modifications do not misrepresent the licensor's original work. The licensee may authorize distributors and platform providers to host and transmit the game containing the assets, but only as necessary to distribute {{product_name}}.

sections.heading: Restrictions
sections.body: The licensee may not sell, sublicense, rent, or distribute the assets as standalone assets. The licensee may not use the assets in a way that is defamatory, obscene, or that infringes the rights of a third party. The licensee may not claim authorship of the assets or register them as trademarks or copyrights. The licensee may not use the assets outside {{product_name}} or for a different project unless the licensor agrees in writing.

sections.heading: License Fee
sections.body: The licensee will pay the licensor {{license_fee}} as the license fee. Unless otherwise stated, the fee is due within thirty days after the effective date or as set out in a separate invoice. The license fee is non-refundable except as expressly provided in this Agreement. The licensee is responsible for any taxes arising from the license, excluding taxes based on the licensor's net income.

sections.heading: Term
sections.body: The license begins on the effective date and continues for {{license_term}}, unless terminated earlier under this Agreement. If the license is for a limited term, the licensee may continue to distribute existing copies of {{product_name}} after the term only to the extent the licensor agrees in writing.

sections.heading: Territory
sections.body: The license is limited to {{territory}}. The licensee may distribute the game containing the assets in that territory, but may not knowingly authorize distribution outside it. The licensor may grant similar licenses to others in other territories unless the license is exclusive.

sections.heading: Ownership
sections.body: The licensor retains all right, title, and interest in and to the assets, including all intellectual property rights. The licensee receives only the license expressly granted in this Agreement. The licensee's modifications to the assets remain subject to the licensor's ownership of the underlying assets.

sections.heading: Credit
sections.body: The licensee will provide the following credit: {{credit_required}}. The credit must be reasonably prominent and in a form approved by the licensor. If the game does not have credits, the licensee will provide the credit in the game's documentation or on the official website.

sections.heading: Warranties
sections.body: The licensor represents and warrants that it owns or has the right to license the assets and that, to its knowledge, the assets do not infringe the intellectual property rights of a third party. The licensee represents and warrants that it has the right to enter into this Agreement and will use the assets in compliance with applicable law. Except as expressly stated, the assets are provided as is without additional warranties.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: Either party may terminate this Agreement for a material breach that is not cured within fifteen days after written notice. The licensor may terminate immediately if the licensee uses the assets outside the permitted scope. On termination, the licensee must stop using the assets, remove them from new builds of {{product_name}} where practicable, and confirm in writing that it has done so. Rights to distribute existing copies will be handled as described in the Term section.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}, without regard to conflict of law rules. The parties agree to the exclusive jurisdiction of {{venue}} for disputes arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

sections.heading: Participation
sections.body: You are participating in {{playtest_name}}, build {{build_version}}, operated by {{company_name}}. The playtest runs from {{playtest_start_date}} to {{playtest_end_date}}, unless {{company_name}} changes the dates or ends the playtest early. Participation is by invitation and is personal to you. You may not share access, download links, keys, or account credentials with anyone else. You must follow all instructions provided by {{company_name}}.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.body: The playtest and all related information are confidential. You may not disclose, publish, stream, record, screenshot, or share gameplay, builds, features, story details, art, audio, or other non-public information about the playtest without {{company_name}} prior written consent. You may discuss the playtest only in designated private channels and only with other approved participants. These obligations continue for {{confidentiality_period_years}} years after the playtest ends and do not apply to information that becomes public through no fault of yours.

sections.heading: Feedback License
sections.body: You may provide suggestions, bug reports, balance feedback, and other input about the playtest. You grant {{company_name}} a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free, irrevocable license to {{feedback_license_scope}}. You waive any right to compensation, attribution, or approval for use of your feedback. {{company_name}} is not obligated to use any feedback.

sections.heading: Playtest Restrictions
sections.body: You may not reverse engineer, decompile, or modify the playtest build; use cheats, bots, or unauthorized tools; attempt to access other participants' accounts or data; exploit bugs for personal gain; or use the playtest for commercial purposes. You may not harass other participants or {{company_name}} staff. You must report security vulnerabilities promptly to {{contact_email}} and must not publicly disclose them before {{company_name}} authorizes disclosure.

sections.heading: Recording and Monitoring
sections.body: {{company_name}} may collect gameplay data, logs, crash reports, and communications for testing, security, and improvement purposes. {{company_name}} may record sessions where permitted by law and with any required notice or consent. Any recording or streaming by you requires prior written permission, except as expressly allowed in the playtest instructions.

sections.heading: Compensation
sections.body: You will receive the following compensation for participating: {{compensation}}. Unless expressly stated, participation is voluntary and does not create an employment, contractor, or agency relationship. You are responsible for any taxes arising from compensation.

sections.heading: Term and Termination
sections.body: This Agreement begins when you accept it and continues until the playtest ends, unless terminated earlier. {{company_name}} may suspend or terminate your participation at any time, including for a violation of this Agreement. On termination, you must stop using the playtest build and delete all copies in your possession. The confidentiality, feedback license, and other provisions that by their nature should survive will survive termination.

sections.heading: Copyright Policy
sections.body: {{company_name}} respects the intellectual property rights of others and expects users of {{website_url}} to do the same. This policy explains how to report alleged copyright infringement and how to respond if your content is removed. {{company_name}} will respond to notices that comply with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) and applicable law. This policy is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}.

sections.heading: Reporting Copyright Infringement
sections.body: To report alleged infringement, send a written notice to the designated agent at {{designated_agent_name}}, {{designated_agent_address}}, or {{dmca_email}}. The notice must include: a physical or electronic signature of the copyright owner or authorized agent; identification of the copyrighted work claimed to be infringed; identification of the material claimed to be infringing, including enough information to locate it; your name, address, telephone number, and email address; a statement that you have a good faith belief that the use is not authorized; a statement that the information in the notice is accurate; and a statement, under penalty of perjury, that you are authorized to act on behalf of the copyright owner.

sections.heading: Counter-Notification
sections.body: If your content was removed and you believe the removal was the result of a mistake or misidentification, you may send a counter-notification to {{counter_notice_address}}. The counter-notification must include: your physical or electronic signature; identification of the removed material and its location before removal; a statement under penalty of perjury that you have a good faith belief the material was removed by mistake or misidentification; your name, address, and telephone number; and a statement that you consent to the jurisdiction of the federal district court for the district where your address is located, or if your address is outside the United States, a judicial district where {{company_name}} may be found, and that you will accept service of process from the person who submitted the original notice or that person's agent.

sections.heading: Repeat Infringers
sections.body: {{company_name}} will {{repeat_infringer_policy}}. {{company_name}} may also remove content, suspend access, or take other appropriate action in response to infringement notices, regardless of whether an account has reached the repeat infringer threshold. {{company_name}} maintains records of infringement notices and actions taken.

sections.heading: Misrepresentations
sections.body: Knowingly submitting a false or misleading infringement notice or counter-notification may result in liability for damages, including costs and attorneys' fees, under the DMCA or other applicable law. {{company_name}} may reject notices that do not substantially comply with the requirements of this policy or applicable law. This policy does not limit any other rights or remedies available to {{company_name}}.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions about this policy, contact {{designated_agent_name}} at {{dmca_email}} or write to {{designated_agent_address}}.

sections.heading: Entry Period

sections.heading: How to Enter

sections.heading: Prizes

sections.heading: Winner Selection and Notification

sections.heading: Claiming the Prize

sections.heading: Commissioned Services
sections.body: {{company_name}} commissions {{contractor_name}} to create the work described below for {{project_description}}. This Agreement takes effect on {{effective_date}}. The contractor will perform the work with reasonable skill and care, follow the project brief, and provide progress updates on request.

sections.heading: Deliverables
sections.body: The contractor will deliver {{deliverables}} in the formats and at the specifications reasonably requested by {{company_name}}. The contractor will deliver all source files and materials needed for {{company_name}} to use, modify, and maintain the work. {{company_name}} may review the deliverables and request reasonable revisions before final acceptance. Deliverables are accepted when {{company_name}} confirms acceptance in writing or uses them commercially.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: {{company_name}} will pay the contractor {{payment_amount}} according to the following schedule: {{payment_schedule}}. The contractor will submit invoices with reasonable supporting detail. {{company_name}} will pay undisputed invoices within thirty days after receipt. The contractor is responsible for all taxes arising from the payment.

sections.heading: Work Made for Hire
sections.body: All deliverables and work product created by the contractor under this Agreement are works made for hire for {{company_name}} to the maximum extent permitted by law. If any work is not a work made for hire, the contractor assigns to {{company_name}} all right, title, and interest in and to the work, including all copyrights and other intellectual property rights, effective on creation. The contractor will execute any documents reasonably requested to confirm or perfect this assignment.

sections.heading: Moral Rights
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, the contractor {{moral_rights_waiver}}. If moral rights cannot be waived, the contractor agrees not to assert them in a way that interferes with {{company_name}} use, modification, or commercialization of the deliverables. The contractor will obtain similar waivers from any approved subcontractors.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.body: The contractor will keep confidential all non-public information received from {{company_name}}, including game designs, source code, builds, business plans, player data, and financial information. The contractor will use this information only to perform the work and will return or destroy it when the engagement ends or on request. These obligations do not apply to information that is publicly available through no fault of the contractor or that the contractor is required to disclose by law, provided the contractor gives {{company_name}} prompt notice where permitted.

sections.heading: Representations and Warranties
sections.body: The contractor represents and warrants that it has the right and authority to enter into this Agreement, that the deliverables will be original or properly licensed, that the deliverables will not infringe the rights of any third party, and that the contractor will comply with applicable laws. The contractor will not incorporate third-party materials into the deliverables without {{company_name}} prior written approval and any required licenses.

sections.heading: Term and Termination
sections.body: This Agreement begins on the effective date and continues until the deliverables are accepted or the Agreement is terminated. Either party may terminate for convenience with {{termination_notice_days}} days' written notice. Either party may terminate immediately for a material breach that is not cured within ten days after written notice. On termination, {{company_name}} will pay for work properly performed and accepted before the effective date of termination, and the contractor will deliver all work in progress. The intellectual property and confidentiality provisions survive termination.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}, without regard to conflict of law rules. The parties agree to the exclusive jurisdiction of {{venue}} for disputes arising out of or relating to this Agreement.
